events.title: Bajaj Pune Grand Tour 2027
events.description: Six-stage professional road race across Pune district, 26–31 January 2027. The official event site lists the Men Elite individual road race as UCI 2.1 (960.12 km), the Pro Men's Race as UCI 2.2 (437 km), and says Gran Fondo details are still to be confirmed. Professional team selection is handled by cycling bodies.
events.poster_note: No standalone poster URL was available on the official event page checked.
events.image_note: Official event track visual from the organiser website; not a race poster.

events.title: Race Across India 2027
events.description: RAIN 3.0 is announced for 28 February 2027 as a 4,100+ km north-to-south ultra-cycling race from Srinagar to Kanyakumari. The organiser's page lists solo and relay formats and different finish cut-offs. The page contains older 2025/2024 text in some sections, so confirm current fees and terms directly before registering.
